title: Indexing in Code: Index Your Own Data and Fields | Orchard Core
description:
The values in a search index come from the handlers that add them to each document. Your own parts, fields, and records have no entries of their own until you write the code that adds them.

This video follows a change from the task log to the index, then writes a part handler, a field handler, and a document index handler, chooses what is indexed in the Lucene index settings, and registers a source for records that are not content items.

In this video:
• How indexing works: profiles, tasks, and handlers
• Index a part with a content part index handler
• Index a field with a content field index handler
• Choose what is indexed: settings, Reset, and Rebuild
• Index any record with a document index handler
• A source of your own: tasks, an indexing service, and a profile handler
